audience: Future studio sessions learning music-driven editing
promise: Picture events can land on measured musical moments without cutting on every beat
cta: Read the music map before choosing cut points
direction: Graphic score visualisation: navy night, cream energy line, a yellow flood on the release

sound.note: Synthetic study track from test/fixture/music-track.mjs; no third-party material

creative.viewer: an editor deciding where a reveal should land
creative.problem: cuts placed by guesswork feel late or early
creative.promise: the music map names quiet holds, builds and the release
creative.motif: a line drawing the music's energy
creative.light: flat graphic, one colour flood at the release
creative.camera: locked frame; the graphic itself moves
creative.motion: beat pulses only on measured beats; one big impact on the release
creative.sound: the track plus a single impact on the release
creative.pacing: quiet hold, rising build, release, settle
creative.payoff: the frame floods yellow exactly on the measured downbeat

shots.purpose: quiet hold: the line breathes, the word waits
build: the line climbs, pulses tighten
release: yellow flood on the measured downbeat, beats pulse
